rows.claim: The agent searched the whole filesystem for campaigns.csv and for any file mentioning conversions and found nothing.
rows.evidence: In T0B4 the agent ran find / -name "campaigns*" and find / -iname "*campaign*" with no results, and in T0B6 ran grep -rIl -i "conversions" / (excluding proc, sys, usr, lib), which only returned /work/README.md. So no campaigns.csv or data file mentioning conversions was found. The grep excluded /usr and /lib, so "whole filesystem" is slightly overstated, but the claim is essentially backed by the outputs.
